selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae, along with hyperkeratotic plaques and specific genetic variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1, strongly support this diagnosis.

support_spans: Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities
hyperkeratotic plaques with distinct borders and annular appearance
hyperkeratosis, spinous cell vacuolization, and vesicles in the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
